mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Long-running thread now centred on 2024 and 2025 production main bearings being out of spec on free spread; the snippet indicates King technical support acknowledged the 2024 batch was defective and advised not using them, with the next production run not until January 2027.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no official King representative has responded and it is not locked or marked resolved.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King main bearing thrust faces over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, framed as a dimensional defect rather than an install error.
